observational_units: Only marked nest-stage individuals with one natal island+year, recorded at one island in the following year; separate immigrant versus resident by natal and next-year destination
t2: Year birth+2: observed on SAME t+1 destination island, observed DIFFERENT island, not reobserved, or multiple destination islands (ambiguous)
complete_reporting: All registered-year groups and natal origin islands with all unknown/ambiguous follow-up categories; no favourable island filtering, no p-values or regression
limitations: Unknown 2-year resighting is NOT death or failed establishment. Same-destination sighting is NOT realized fitness or offspring production. Detection effort and island habitat prior published, no new independent 2021/2026 experiments.
